notes.title: Update 1.0.2 New Stage and Feature
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

It's been a while but we are back with a new stage as promised. This update adds a fifth stage in the game. This stage is a bit different from the previous ones. Most of the graphics you see here, even the tile-sets are digitally drawn. Just thought it would be a fun idea to implement. Besides that, it also brings a stage selector option. So, now you can choose a specific stage to play from the main menu. Stuck at some point of a stage? No problemo! You can use the stage selector to try a different stage. However, in order to get all the achievements, you have to play and complete every stage. Oh, and yes, there's a new achievement, too.

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! Here's a little update on the development progress of Kitty's Venture. 

We mentioned on our Steam page that the game will have three different stages. The designing of the first two stages is complete. Now, we are working on the third stage. There's still a lot of other things that we need to work on such as UI designing, audio, achievements designing and integration, controls, etc. After all that, we plan to do an extensive testing to make sure that there's no bug, and the game is not bizarrely difficult. The good news is that we have made really good progress with the development, and it happened faster than we first expected. If everything proceeds according to plan, we will be able to release the game in September. However, if for some reason that is not possible, we will consider releasing it in October. But for now, September is looking good! 

In the meantime, don't forget to Wishlist the game, and share it with friends! 
Thank you!
Red Bean Games
